gloss: to smell; to be fragrant; to stink

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {匂|にお}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to smell; to give off a smell
definitions.explanation: To emit an odor, whether pleasant or unpleasant.

definitions.gloss: to be fragrant; to smell nice
to smack of; to hint at
definitions.explanation: To suggest or give an impression of something (figurative).

notes:
{匂|にお}う is intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). There is no common transitive pair.

ASPECT (ている):
{匂|にお}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing state of smelling or giving off an odor.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{匂|にお}う: the thing that gives off the smell (⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{匂|にお}う)
- ⟦ほのか→ほのか：31228_honoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ / かすか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{匂|にお}う: to smell faintly
- ⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧ / ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{匂|にお}う: something seems suspicious (figurative)

WATCH OUT:
⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{匂|にお}う repeats itself; say ⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (it smells nice).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{臭|くさ}い→臭い：01133_kusai⟧: Adjective meaning "smelly/stinky" (negative)
- ⟦{香|かお}る→香る：14841_kaoru⟧: More literary, typically positive fragrance
- ⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧: Noun form meaning "smell/scent"

Written {臭|にお}う, the verb is used for bad smells: ⟦{生|なま}ゴミ→生ゴミ：08044_namagomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{臭|にお}う (the kitchen waste stinks).
